RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the March 7, 2008/Phalguna 17, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
37
Suicide by farmers
†*121. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during the
last few years incidents of suicide by the
farmers in lakhs of number have come to
the notice of Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof,  State-wise;
(c) whether Government has formulated
any action plan to improve the economic
situation of the farmers and to make
agriculture a profitable job; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Health hazard of tobacco
*122. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA:
SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the dimension/statistics pertaining
to health hazard by tobacco;
(b) how many tobacco-related deaths
occur in the country daily /annually;
(c) whether 40 per cent of all health
problems in the country are due to tobacco
and the Centre is spending Rs. 45 crores
thereon;
(d) whether a powerful lobby is
opposing war against tobacco;
(e) what measures are being taken to
effectively enforce total ban on smoking in
public; and
(f) how hazardous is ‘GUTKA’ and what
is his Ministry's stand regarding its ban?
Garib Rath
†*123. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY : Will the Minister of RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of 'Garib Rath' trains
which have started running so far as per
announcement made in the last Railway
Budget;
(b) whether any of such trains have not
started/running so far;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

38
(d) by when the remaining 'Garib Rath'
trains are likely to be started?
Supreme Court notice on Sale of
Spurious drugs
*124. SHRI UDAY PRATAP SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Supreme
Court has issued Notice to M/s Cadila
Health Care for selling sub-standard drugs
which are unfit for human consumption;
and
(b) if so, what are the complete details
and action being taken by Government?
Cases of AIDS in Orissa
*125. SHRI B. J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that AIDS is
spreading its tentacles in coastal districts
of Orissa;
(b) whether it is also a fact that one of the
causes for its fast spread is the foreign tourists
and infiltrators from Bangladesh; and
(c) if so, what is the action plan of the
Centre to help the State, both financially
and physically, to control this menace?
Indo-US initiative on agriculture
*126. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ:
SHRI RAJKUMAR
DHOOT:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether under the Indo-US initiative
on agriculture, US seed companies are being
given access to Indian seed gene bank; and
(b) if so, on what terms?
Throwing out of railway staff and
passengers from running
trains
*127. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR : Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS  be pleased to state:
(a) how many cases of railway staff
and passengers having been thrown out
from running trains have been reported
during 2007;
(b) the number of railway personnel and
others who lost their lives and were
seriously injured in such cases;
(c) the action taken against those
responsible for such cases; and
(d) the compensation paid to those who
suffered in such cases by Railways and
other authorities, case-wise?
Bird-flu cases
*128. SHRI K.CHANDRAN
PILLAI:
SHRIMATI  SUSHMA
SWARAJ:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether cases of bird-flu have been
reported from various parts of the country;
(b) if so, the details of areas affected by
the situation;
(c) the assessed financial loss;
(d) whether Government has put in
place effective preventive measures; and
(e) the details of the financial relief
provided to the affected farmers?

39
Special packages for farmers of Kerala
*129. SHRI  A. VIJAYARAGHAV AN:
SHRI P. R. RAJAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) how many special packages have
been announced by Government for the
farmers of Kerala; and
(b) the details of money and other
materials distributed by the Centre through
the scheme in Kerala?
Shortage of fertilizers
†*130. SHRI DATTA MEGHE : Will
the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there was a
shortage of fertilizers for farmers in some
States during the last year;
(b) if so, the steps taken to ensure the
timely availability of fertilizers to farmers
in future;
(c) whether Government is framing new
urea policy to meet the shortage of
fertilizers; and
(d) if so, whether Government would
restart those fertilizer plants which had been
closed earlier, alongwith the details thereof?
Rise in the prices of edible oil
*131. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM :
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether edible oil prices and palm
oil prices in various parts of the country
have gone up in domestic market;
(b) if so, whether the prices have gone
up by Rs. 1.5 per kg. for all edible oils
since December, 2007 and in Mumbai local
markets the palm oil prices are ruling at
Rs. 525/- per 10 kg.; and
(c) if so, what steps Government
proposes to take to check the rise of edible
oil prices in the country?
Survey of rail routes in Rajasthan
†*132. DR. PRABHA THAKUR : Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of rail routes in Rajasthan
on which survey would be completed by
the year 2008;
(b) the number of rail routes in the
country particularly in Rajasthan, on which
survey has been undertaken in Rail Budget
2007-08; and
(c) the details of the progress made so
far in this regard and the target fixed to
complete the work where survey has been
completed ?
Pending projects for gauge conversion
in Tamil Nadu
*133. SHRI B. S. GNANADESIKAN:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS  be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of projects which are
pending for conversion from meter gauge
to broad gauge in the State of Tamil Nadu;
(b) whether there is any delay in
executing these projects;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether due to delay in execution of
the above projects there was any cost
escalation; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Promotion of agricultural research
*134. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state what
steps are being taken by Government to
promote agricultural research in the country
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

40
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
and what is the fund allocation for such
research and how much of this is spent on
promoting young agricultural scientists?
Violation of Human Organ
Transplantation Act
*135. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
not a single conviction has taken place since
the enactment of Human Organ
Transplantation Act 14 years back, despite
the fact that several kidney rackets have
been busted during this period;
(b) if so, what are the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that offenders
arrested in such cases from hospitals get
released soon thereafter and seldom face
prosecution; and
(d) if so, what steps Government
proposes to take to secure the conviction
of offenders involved in kidney racket?
Incidents of looting in trains
†*136. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA:
SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that incidents of
looting passengers by offering them food
laced with drugs have increased in the past
few days;
(b) if so, whether Government has taken
any steps for the security of passengers
and their luggage; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Employees in PSUs
*137. SHRI MOHAMMED AMIN:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of permanent employees
working in public sector undertakings under
the administrative control of his Ministry
as on 31st March 2007; unit-wise; and
(b) the number of contract/casual/
contingency workers working in these units
as on 31st March 2007?
Amendment in Human Organ
Transplantation Act
*138. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
introduce any amendment in the existing
law to provide for more stringent
punishment for illegal kidney transplant;
(b) the details of the proposed
amendment, if any;
(c) whether the proposed bill to regulate
clinical establishments which is presently
before the Standing Committee would also
deal with the matter; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Modest growth in agriculture and
allied services
*139. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARW AL:
SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:

41
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 1st March, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 11, 1929 (Saka)
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
data released by the Central Statistical
Organisation, there is modest growth in
agriculture and allied services during
2007-08;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) what are the reasons for low growth
in the production of foodgrains during
2007-08; and
(d) the steps being taken for the growth
of agriculture sector during the next two
years?
PCPIR in Gujarat
*140. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Gujarat
Industrial Development Corporation has
submitted an application for setting up
Petroleum, Chemical and Petrochemicals
Investment Region (PCPIR) at Dahej in
Gujarat; and
(b) if so, the status thereof?
